problem: EqLM at 93% of explicit-baseline BLiMP at 2.9x wall-clock; depth must be simultaneously many (quality) and few (cost) iterations
classification: physical contradiction (depth many AND few) + technical (28 accuracy vs 21 power; 27 reliability vs 22 loss)
separation: system-level (one solver = depth + reasoning dial + confidence)

solutions.name: S1 per-token adaptive depth / early exit

decision: ADR 0004: H1' program - adaptive equilibrium computation (warm-start decoding, per-token early exit, eval-time budget scaling); parity remains a secondary reported metric

contradiction: adaptability (per-question collective evidence) vs reliability/accuracy (specialist dominance where router wins)
mechanism: Magnetically anchored answer vote (MAAV): router = reference policy of QRE over answer equivalence classes; council overrides anchor only when net vote margin exceeds magnet strength tau; contains router as tau->inf limit so floor is the baseline by construction
kinetic_core: MMD magnet in policy space (F21), QRE rationality, ladder-fixed truthful weights; answer classes neutralise tokenizer mismatch (F37) and verbosity confound (exp23 letteronly)
test: exp27 offline over exp23 candidates, 3-fold held-out, zero GPU cost

contradiction: measurement accuracy (identify who is right per question) vs difficulty of detecting (no signal in the score field; F30/F32 showed correctness is not legible from score shape)
mechanism: Stability-under-perturbation as verifiable bid (SUPV): weight each player by empirical answer-stability over k resamples/paraphrases rather than single-pass confidence; adaptive triggering only on disagreement
why_it_escapes_prior_negatives: every refuted rule reweighted ONE observation per player; stability is a SECOND observation, unavailable to reweighting, which is exactly what F30's impossibility argument leaves open
kinetic_core: QRE rationality parameter estimated empirically per question; F6 truthful bidding made verifiable (a player cannot claim stability it does not exhibit)
gates_on: F42's condition — must be tested on a council where one member dominates (the Falcon council), since that is where routing gives zero and only a per-question signal can help

contradiction: device complexity (need 12 distinct maps' expressiveness) vs quantity of substance (must keep 1 block's parameters, which is the entire contribution)
mechanism: Depth-conditioned tied block (DCTB): per-iteration FiLM scale/shift modulates the single shared block, making it a time-varying map f(z,x,t) instead of a static one
cost: 2*d per iteration = 18K params vs 78M for untying, ~4000x cheaper; compute unchanged (elementwise)
kinetic_core: the fixed point becomes the equilibrium of a periodically time-varying dynamical system; the magnet/QRE framing is unaffected since only the map is modulated
target: close the 3.2% gap in F45 (0.968 -> >1.0) while keeping parameters at ~46M vs 123.8M
